title: The repr-t artifact record is CLOSED for the entire row set: s34x reproduces all four old LOW anchors bit-exactly (dt = 0.0) at their repr heights in fresh dps-40 processes - the s34w resolution-floor finding (the 53-bit width estimate quantizes the term count to ~9..90 units at 6e16..6e17, so 2..48-unit shifts are invisible at dps-15 but visible at the s25 dps-40) is confirmed; s34k boundary probe clean (C and mpmath dps-15/dps-40 agree at a = 5.9e8 - no dps collapse); the static data reading guide is generated (docs/DATA-LEDGER.md, 11 rows, all values machine-pulled); MFar.lean pinGates gains a scale gate for Gc (Gc was already correctly scaled - the flagged bug was a misdiagnosis, now machine-checked either way); full formal tree green
body: CLOSURE MILESTONE for the far-anchor adjudication (no RH claim;  everything below is data bookkeeping).  (1) s34w at dps-15 had shown the four low-row repr offsets (2e6G -2, 5e6G +12, 1e7G +24, 2e7G +48) INVISIBLE:  fresh dps-15 mpmath at the repr heights returned the exact-t values to 1e-11 while the old s25 anchors sit O(1) away.  Mechanism:  mpmath's rszeta width estimate (the ctx.prec = 53 branch) quantizes the sieved term count;  at 6e16..6e17 that is an effective height resolution of ~9..90 units, below which shifts do not move the value.  (2) s34x (fresh process per height, dps-40 = the s25 census setting, source-verified mpf(repr(t)) at workdps(40)):  2e6G repr t-2 -> -0.8770866008849694 (old -0.8770866008849694, dt = 0.0);  5e6G repr t+12 -> 0.2604606616623537 (dt = 0.0);  1e7G repr t+24 -> 1.639866401622982 (dt = 0.0);  2e7G repr t+48 -> -0.4652521468916362 (dt = 0.0) - ALL FOUR OLD LOW ANCHORS BIT-EXACT at their repr heights (tmp/s34x_lowrepr_dps40.log);  the exact-2e6G control comes back 0.8654680816359783 = canonical to 1 ulp (the exact value is dps-stable).  The repr-t artifact record is now closed for the ENTIRE row set:  every old census anchor, low (2..48 units, dps-40 resolution) and high (120..256 units, dps-15-visible), is the true zeta value at the repr height under the original census digit setting.  mpmath 1.4.1 has not been shown wrong at any height or digit setting in this audit.  (3) s34k boundary probe (t = 2190076357998684160,  a = 5.9039e8,  between the verified-clean 4.886e8 point and 1e8G):  C/quad = -1.863686420607;  fresh mpmath dps-15 = -1.8636864206066681;  fresh mpmath dps-40 = -1.8636864206066681 (bit-identical through 17 digits) - NO precision- or dps-induced discrepancy at the boundary;  the historical 'dps-40 collapse' readings join the far anchors as the same height / artifact class.  (4) THE STATIC DATA READING GUIDE:  docs/DATA-LEDGER.md, generated by scripts/rh/s34p_ledger.py from the on-disk data files (no hand-entered table values):  11 rows with exact f64 integer heights (full), repr offsets, the true-floored N (verified at 100-digit precision;  smallest sqrt-space margin 45 at 5e8G), the C channel-of-record logzeta (the 5e8G row re-anchored at full 12 digits by s34q2:  2.937019955061), full/bare |Z|, the mpmath exact-t crosses, M (all exactly quantized), the M-identity component table (eps, lm, la, re, I_far as recorded), the far-law drift table pinned in Lean, the channel definitions, the repr-t artifact record with per-row reproduction evidence, the file map, and the trap list (T1 repr-t, T2 double-t quantization, T3 12-digit printing, T4 misattributed width capture, T5 memory wall).  Ground rules R1-R8:  f64 heights, the channel of record, mpmath as cross-check with the wall [9e18,3e19), the repr rule with the resolution floor, the left-to-right f64 M identity, provenance, the |Z| columns, and the N convention (mpmath n_terms may run N-1 at 5e8G - harmless:  the R-term imbalance parameter p rebalances;  the true N is pinned by the 100-digit check).  (5) FORMAL:  MFar.lean pinGates gains clause (0) - t9/Gc in [0.99999, 1.00001]*1e9 - machine-checking the row scale;  the Gc value ((30001045999981975555 : R)/10^9 = 3.0001045999981975555e10) was already correctly scaled:  the earlier flagged '1e6 off' bug was a misdiagnosis, and the gate now makes the scale provably right regardless.  Full formal tree rebuild green (17450 jobs);  cards regenerated (96 cards / 715 body lines);  _MAP current.  (6) DOCS:  docs/MPMATH-RSSUM-ISSUE.md verdict updated to closure (items 4-7:  5e8G two-state closed, resolution floor, boundary, ledger pointer);  PATHWAY B7 block carries the ledger pointer and the closure line.  No RH claim.  Next formal work:  the B7 face wiring consuming the MFar pins, alongside the named residual faces (hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low, S4Blind.s4OpenFace).
